fuzzy_matches.source_text:
On that occasion, with ignorance as condition, a formation associated with ignorance; with the formation as condition, consciousness associated with the formation; with consciousness as condition, mentality associated with consciousness; with mentality as condition, the sixth sense-field associated with mentality; with the sixth sense-field as condition, contact associated with the sixth sense-field; with contact as condition, feeling associated with contact; with feeling as condition, craving associated with feeling; with craving as condition, clinging associated with craving; with clinging as condition, existence; with existence as condition, birth; with birth as condition, aging and death. Thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.
265. Therein, what is ignorance? The lack of knowledge, lack of vision… the barrier of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root — this is called "ignorance".
Therein, what is the formation that has ignorance as condition, associated with ignorance? The intention, intending, state of intending — this is called "the formation that has ignorance as condition, associated with ignorance".
Therein, what is the consciousness that has the formation as condition, associated with the formation? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the consciousness that has the formation as condition, associated with the formation".
Therein, what is the mentality that has consciousness as condition, associated with consciousness? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations — this is called "the mentality that has consciousness as condition, associated with consciousness".
Therein, what is the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition, associated with mentality? The mind, mentality, mental activity… the corresponding mind-consciousness element — this is called "the sixth sense-field that has mentality as condition, associated with mentality".
Therein, what is the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition, associated with the sixth sense-field? The contact, touching, being in contact, state of being in contact — this is called "the contact that has the sixth sense-field as condition, associated with the sixth sense-field".
Therein, what is the feeling that has contact as condition, associated with contact? Mental comfort, mental happiness, the comfortable happy experience born of mind-contact, the comfortable happy feeling born of mind-contact — this is called "the feeling that has contact as condition, associated with contact".
Therein, what is the craving that has feeling as condition, associated with feeling? The lust, passion… passion of the mind — this is called "the craving that has feeling as condition, associated with feeling".
Therein, what is the clinging that has craving as condition, associated with craving? The view, resort to views… the sectarian domain, the distorted grip — this is called "the clinging that has craving as condition, associated with craving"… therefore it is said, "thus there is the origin of this entire mass of suffering".

As a single class, the aggregate of feeling is this: it is joined with contact.
As a twofold class: there is feeling joined with the yokes, and feeling dissociated from them.
As a threefold class: there is feeling with an internal object, feeling with an external object, and feeling with an object both internal and external… Thus the aggregate of feeling is classified up to ten ways.
The set expanding from both sides.
As a sevenfold class, the aggregate of feeling is this: there is wholesome feeling, unwholesome feeling, neutral feeling, feeling belonging to the sense sphere, feeling belonging to the fine-material sphere, feeling belonging to the immaterial sphere, and feeling not included in any sphere. This is the aggregate of feeling as a sevenfold class.
As another sevenfold class: there is feeling that is a result… feeling with an internal object, feeling with an external object, feeling with an object both internal and external, feeling belonging to the sense sphere, feeling belonging to the fine-material sphere, feeling belonging to the immaterial sphere, and feeling not included in any sphere. This is the aggregate of feeling as a sevenfold class.
As a twenty-fourfold class, the aggregate of feeling is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of feeling may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of feeling may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; and there is feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact, and feeling born of mind-contact. This is the aggregate of feeling as a twenty-fourfold class.

This is the aggregate of feeling as a twenty-fourfold class.

The aggregate of mental formations may be a root cause with root causes, may have root causes without being a root cause, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a root cause joined with root causes" or as "joined with root causes without being a root cause". Three aggregates cannot be described as "root causes joined with root causes"; they may be joined with root causes without being root causes, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a root cause joined with root causes, may be joined with root causes without being a root cause, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is not a root cause and is without root causes. Three aggregates may be not root causes with root causes, or not root causes without root causes. The aggregate of mental formations may be not a root cause with root causes, not a root cause without root causes, or not describable as either.
All five have conditions and are compounded.
Four aggregates are invisible. The aggregate of material form may be visible or invisible. Four aggregates offer no resistance. The aggregate of material form may offer resistance or not. The aggregate of material form is material. The other four aggregates are immaterial. The aggregate of material form is worldly. The other four aggregates may be worldly or beyond the world; all are knowable by some kinds of consciousness and not knowable by others.
Four aggregates are not mental taints. The aggregate of mental formations may be a taint or not. The aggregate of material form is subject to the taints. The other four aggregates may be subject to the taints or free of them. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the taints. The other four aggregates may be joined with the taints or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a taint subject to the taints"; it is subject to the taints without being a taint. Three aggregates cannot be described as "taints subject to the taints"; they may be subject to the taints without being taints, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a taint subject to the taints, may be subject to the taints without being a taint, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a taint joined with the taints" or as "joined with the taints without being a taint". Three aggregates cannot be described as "taints joined with the taints"; they may be joined with the taints without being taints, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a taint joined with the taints, may be joined with the taints without being a taint, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the taints yet subject to them. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the taints yet subject to them, dissociated from them and free of them, or not describable as either.
Four aggregates are not fetters. The aggregate of mental formations may be a fetter or not. The aggregate of material form can be bound by the fetters. The other four aggregates may be able to be bound or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the fetters. The other four aggregates may be joined with the fetters or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a fetter that can be bound"; it can be bound without being a fetter. Three aggregates cannot be described as "fetters that can be bound"; they may be able to be bound without being fetters, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a fetter that can be bound, may be able to be bound without being a fetter, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a fetter joined with the fetters" or as "joined with the fetters without being a fetter". Three aggregates cannot be described as "fetters joined with the fetters"; they may be joined with the fetters without being fetters, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a fetter joined with the fetters, may be joined with the fetters without being a fetter, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the fetters yet able to be bound. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the fetters yet able to be bound, dissociated from them and unable to be bound, or not describable as either.
Four aggregates are not ties. The aggregate of mental formations may be a tie or not. The aggregate of material form can be tied. The other four aggregates may be able to be tied or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the ties. The other four aggregates may be joined with the ties or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a tie that can be tied"; it can be tied without being a tie. Three aggregates cannot be described as "ties that can be tied"; they may be able to be tied without being ties, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a tie that can be tied, may be able to be tied without being a tie, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a tie joined with the ties" or as "joined with the ties without being a tie". Three aggregates cannot be described as "ties joined with the ties"; they may be joined with the ties without being ties, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a tie joined with the ties, may be joined with the ties without being a tie, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the ties yet able to be tied. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the ties yet able to be tied, dissociated from them and unable to be tied, or not describable as either.
Four aggregates are not floods… not yokes… not hindrances. The aggregate of mental formations may be a hindrance or not. The aggregate of material form can be obstructed by the hindrances. The other four aggregates may be able to be obstructed or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the hindrances. The other four aggregates may be joined with the hindrances or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a hindrance that can be obstructed"; it can be obstructed without being a hindrance. Three aggregates cannot be described as "hindrances that can be obstructed"; they may be able to be obstructed without being hindrances, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a hindrance that can be obstructed, may be able to be obstructed without being a hindrance, or may not be describable as either. Three aggregates cannot be described as "hindrances joined with the hindrances"; they may be joined with the hindrances without being hindrances, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a hindrance joined with the hindrances, may be joined with the hindrances without being a hindrance, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the hindrances yet able to be obstructed. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the hindrances yet able to be obstructed, dissociated from them and unable to be obstructed, or not describable as either.
Four aggregates are not wrong grasping. The aggregate of mental formations may be wrong grasping or not. The aggregate of material form can be wrongly grasped. The other four aggregates may be able to be wrongly grasped or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from wrong grasping. Three aggregates may be joined with wrong grasping or dissociated from it. The aggregate of mental formations may be joined with wrong grasping, dissociated from it, or not describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "wrong grasping that can be wrongly grasped"; it can be wrongly grasped without being wrong grasping. Three aggregates cannot be described as "wrong grasping that can be wrongly grasped"; they may be able to be wrongly grasped without being wrong grasping, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be wrong grasping that can be wrongly grasped, may be able to be wrongly grasped without being wrong grasping, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from wrong grasping yet able to be wrongly grasped. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from wrong grasping yet able to be wrongly grasped, dissociated from it and unable to be wrongly grasped, or not describable as either.
The aggregate of material form has no object. The other four aggregates have objects. The aggregate of consciousness is mind. The other four aggregates are not mind. Three aggregates are mental factors. Two aggregates are not mental factors. Three aggregates are joined with mind. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from mind. The aggregate of consciousness cannot be described as "joined with mind" or as "dissociated from mind". Three aggregates are mingled with mind. The aggregate of material form is not mingled with mind. The aggregate of consciousness cannot be described as "mingled with mind" or as "not mingled with mind". Three aggregates are produced by mind. The aggregate of consciousness is not produced by mind. The aggregate of material form may be produced by mind or not. Three aggregates arise together with mind. The aggregate of consciousness does not arise together with mind. The aggregate of material form may arise together with mind or not. Three aggregates follow along with mind. The aggregate of consciousness does not follow along with mind. The aggregate of material form may follow along with mind or not. Three aggregates are mingled with mind and produced by it. Two aggregates are not mingled with mind and produced by it. Three aggregates are mingled with mind, produced by it, and arise together with it. Two aggregates are not. Three aggregates are mingled with mind, produced by it, and follow along with it. Two aggregates are not.
The aggregate of consciousness is internal. Three aggregates are external. The aggregate of material form may be internal or external. Four aggregates are not derived. The aggregate of material form may be derived or not derived, may be taken up at birth or not taken up. Four aggregates are not clinging. The aggregate of mental formations may be clinging or not. The aggregate of material form can be clung to. The other four aggregates may be able to be clung to or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from clinging. The other four aggregates may be joined with clinging or dissociated from it. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "clinging that can be clung to"; it can be clung to without being clinging. Three aggregates cannot be described as "clinging that can be clung to"; they may be able to be clung to without being clinging, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be clinging that can be clung to, may be able to be clung to without being clinging, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "clinging joined with clinging" or as "joined with clinging without being clinging". Three aggregates cannot be described as "clinging joined with clinging"; they may be joined with clinging without being clinging, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be clinging joined with clinging, may be joined with clinging without being clinging, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from clinging yet able to be clung to. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from clinging yet able to be clung to, dissociated from it and unable to be clung to, or not describable as either.
Four aggregates are not defilements. The aggregate of mental formations may be a defilement or not. The aggregate of material form is open to defilement. The other four aggregates may be open to defilement or not. The aggregate of material form is undefiled. The other four aggregates may be defiled or undefiled. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the defilements. The other four aggregates may be joined with the defilements or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a defilement open to defilement"; it is open to defilement without being a defilement. Three aggregates cannot be described as "defilements open to defilement"; they may be open to defilement without being defilements, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a defilement open to defilement, may be open to defilement without being a defilement, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a defilement that is defiled" or as "defiled without being a defilement". Three aggregates cannot be described as "defilements that are defiled"; they may be defiled without being defilements, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a defilement that is defiled, may be defiled without being a defilement, or may not be describable as either.
The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a defilement joined with the defilements" or as "joined with the defilements without being a defilement". Three aggregates cannot be described as "defilements joined with the defilements"; they may be joined with the defilements without being defilements, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a defilement joined with the defilements, may be joined with the defilements without being a defilement, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the defilements yet open to defilement. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the defilements yet open to defilement, dissociated from them and not open to defilement, or not describable as either.
The aggregate of material form is not to be abandoned by seeing. The other four aggregates may be abandoned by seeing or not. The aggregate of material form is not to be abandoned by meditative development. The other four aggregates may be abandoned by development or not. The aggregate of material form does not have root causes to be abandoned by seeing. The other four aggregates may have root causes to be abandoned by seeing or not. The aggregate of material form does not have root causes to be abandoned by development. The other four aggregates may have root causes to be abandoned by development or not. The aggregate of material form is without thought. The other four aggregates may have thought or not. The aggregate of material form is without examination. The other four aggregates may have examination or not. The aggregate of material form is without joy. The other four aggregates may have joy or not. The aggregate of material form is not accompanied by joy. The other four aggregates may be accompanied by joy or not. Two aggregates are not accompanied by happiness. Three aggregates may be accompanied by happiness or not. Two aggregates are not accompanied by equanimity. Three aggregates may be accompanied by equanimity or not.
The aggregate of material form belongs to the sense sphere. The other four aggregates may belong to the sense sphere or not. The aggregate of material form does not belong to the fine-material sphere. The other four aggregates may belong to the fine-material sphere or not. The aggregate of material form does not belong to the immaterial sphere. The other four aggregates may belong to the immaterial sphere or not. The aggregate of material form is included in the round of existence. The other four aggregates may be included in the round of existence or outside it. The aggregate of material form does not lead out of the round. The other four aggregates may lead out of the round or not. The aggregate of material form is not fixed in its outcome. The other four aggregates may be fixed or not fixed. The aggregate of material form can be surpassed. The other four aggregates may be surpassable or unsurpassable. The aggregate of material form is free from conflict. The other four aggregates may involve conflict or be free from conflict.
The Section of Questions and Answers is finished.
The Analysis of the Aggregates is finished.

content: Therein, what is consciousness that is far? Unwholesome consciousness is far from wholesome and neutral consciousness; wholesome and neutral consciousness is far from unwholesome consciousness; wholesome consciousness is far from unwholesome and neutral consciousness; unwholesome and neutral consciousness is far from wholesome consciousness; neutral consciousness is far from wholesome and unwholesome consciousness; wholesome and unwholesome consciousness is far from neutral consciousness. Consciousness joined with painful feeling is far from consciousness joined with pleasant feeling and with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant; consciousness joined with pleasant feeling and with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant is far from consciousness joined with painful feeling; consciousness joined with pleasant feeling is far from consciousness joined with painful feeling and with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant; consciousness joined with painful feeling and with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant is far from consciousness joined with pleasant feeling; consciousness joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant is far from consciousness joined with pleasant and painful feelings; consciousness joined with pleasant and painful feelings is far from consciousness joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. The consciousness of someone not in meditative absorption is far from the consciousness of someone in absorption; the consciousness of someone in absorption is far from the consciousness of someone not in absorption. Consciousness connected with the defilements is far from consciousness free of the defilements; consciousness free of the defilements is far from consciousness connected with the defilements. This is called consciousness that is far. ⤵ Therein, what is consciousness that is near? Unwholesome consciousness is near to unwholesome consciousness; wholesome consciousness is near to wholesome consciousness; neutral consciousness is near to neutral consciousness. Consciousness joined with painful feeling is near to consciousness joined with painful feeling; consciousness joined with pleasant feeling is near to consciousness joined with pleasant feeling; consciousness joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant is near to consciousness joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. The consciousness of someone not in meditative absorption is near to the consciousness of someone not in absorption; the consciousness of someone in absorption is near to the consciousness of someone in absorption. Consciousness connected with the defilements is near to consciousness connected with the defilements; consciousness free of the defilements is near to consciousness free of the defilements. This is called consciousness that is near. But consciousness should also be understood as far or near only relative to this or that other consciousness.
The Classification According to the Discourses is finished.

content: Therein, what is the aggregate of material form? As a single class, the aggregate of material form is this: all material form is not a root cause, is without root causes, is dissociated from root causes; it exists with conditions, is compounded, is material; it is worldly, subject to the mental taints, able to bind with the fetters, able to tie with the ties, able to sweep away with the floods, able to yoke with the yokes, able to obstruct with the hindrances, able to be wrongly grasped, able to be clung to, open to defilement; it is neutral, without an object, not a mental factor, dissociated from mind; it is neither a result nor something that produces results; it is undefiled yet open to defilement; it is not accompanied by both thought and examination, not accompanied by examination alone, but without both thought and examination; it is not accompanied by joy, not accompanied by happiness, not accompanied by equanimity; it is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by meditative development, and its root causes are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development; it neither leads to further accumulation nor to dismantling; it belongs neither to trainees nor to those beyond training; it is limited, belongs to the sense sphere, does not belong to the fine-material sphere, does not belong to the immaterial sphere; it is included in the round of existence, not outside it; it is not fixed in its outcome, does not lead out of the round; it is arisen, and can be known by the six kinds of consciousness; it is impermanent and overcome by aging. This is the aggregate of material form as a single class. ⤵ As a twofold class, the aggregate of material form is this: there is material form that is derived, and material form that is not derived. There is material form that is taken up at birth, and material form that is not. There is material form that is taken up and can be clung to, and material form that is not taken up but can be clung to. There is material form that is visible, and material form that is invisible. There is material form that offers resistance, and material form that does not. There is material form that is a faculty, and material form that is not. There is material form that is a great element, and material form that is not. There is material form that is bodily or verbal expression, and material form that is not. There is material form produced by mind, and material form not produced by mind. There is material form that arises together with mind, and material form that does not. There is material form that follows along with mind, and material form that does not. There is material form that is internal, and material form that is external. There is material form that is coarse, and material form that is subtle. There is material form that is far, and material form that is near… there is material form that is physical food, and material form that is not physical food. This is the aggregate of material form as a twofold class. ⤵ (As this was analysed in the Chapter on Material Form, so it should be analysed here.) ⤵ As a threefold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form that is internal is derived; material form that is external may be derived or not derived. Material form that is internal is taken up at birth; material form that is external may be taken up or not taken up. Material form that is internal is taken up and can be clung to; material form that is external may be taken up and clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to… material form that is internal is not physical food; material form that is external may be physical food or not physical food. This is the aggregate of material form as a threefold class. ⤵ As a fourfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form that is derived may be taken up at birth or not taken up; material form that is not derived may be taken up or not taken up. Material form that is derived may be taken up and clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to; material form that is not derived may be taken up and clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to. Material form that is derived may offer resistance or not; material form that is not derived may offer resistance or not. Material form that is derived may be coarse or subtle; material form that is not derived may be coarse or subtle. Material form that is derived may be far or near; material form that is not derived may be far or near… and there is material form that is seen, heard, sensed, and cognized. This is the aggregate of material form as a fourfold class. ⤵ As a fivefold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the earth element, the water element, the fire element, the air element, and the material form derived from them. This is the aggregate of material form as a fivefold class. ⤵ As a sixfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form knowable by the eye, knowable by the ear, knowable by the nose, knowable by the tongue, knowable by the body, and knowable by the mind. This is the aggregate of material form as a sixfold class. ⤵ As a sevenfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form knowable by the eye, knowable by the ear, knowable by the nose, knowable by the tongue, knowable by the body, knowable by the mind element, and knowable by the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of material form as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form knowable by the eye, knowable by the ear, knowable by the nose, knowable by the tongue, knowable by the body – which may bring pleasant contact or painful contact – knowable by the mind element, and knowable by the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of material form as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the faculty of femininity, the faculty of masculinity, the life faculty, and material form that is not a faculty. This is the aggregate of material form as a ninefold class. ⤵ As a tenfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the faculty of femininity, the faculty of masculinity, the life faculty, and material form that is not a faculty – which may offer resistance or not. This is the aggregate of material form as a tenfold class. ⤵ As an elevenfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the eye sense-field, the ear sense-field, the nose sense-field, the tongue sense-field, the body sense-field, the sense-field of sights, the sense-field of sounds, the sense-field of smells, the sense-field of tastes, the sense-field of things touched, and the material form that is invisible, without resistance, and included in the sense-field of mental objects. This is the aggregate of material form as an elevenfold class.
This is called the aggregate of material form.

As a threefold class: there are formations with an internal object, formations with an external object, and formations with an object both internal and external… Thus the aggregate of mental formations is classified up to ten ways.
The set expanding from both sides.
As a sevenfold class, the aggregate of mental formations is this: there are wholesome formations, unwholesome formations, neutral formations; formations belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and formations not included in any sphere. This is the aggregate of mental formations as a sevenfold class.
As another sevenfold class: there are formations joined with pleasant feeling, formations joined with painful feeling, formations joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant; formations belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and formations not included in any sphere… there are formations with an internal object, formations with an external object, formations with an object both internal and external; formations belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and formations not included in any sphere. This is the aggregate of mental formations as a sevenfold class.
As a twenty-fourfold class, the aggregate of mental formations is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; and there is intention born of eye-contact… intention born of mind-contact. This is the aggregate of mental formations as a twenty-fourfold class.
As another twenty-fourfold class: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may be joined with pleasant feeling… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external; and there is intention born of eye-contact… intention born of mind-contact; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may be joined with pleasant feeling… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external; and there is intention born of eye-contact, intention born of ear-contact, intention born of nose-contact, intention born of tongue-contact, intention born of body-contact, and intention born of mind-contact. This is the aggregate of mental formations as a twenty-fourfold class.
As a thirtyfold class, the aggregate of mental formations is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; and there is intention born of eye-contact… intention born of mind-contact. This is the aggregate of mental formations as a thirtyfold class.
As a manifold class, the aggregate of mental formations is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; and there is intention born of eye-contact, intention born of ear-contact, intention born of nose-contact, intention born of tongue-contact, intention born of body-contact, and intention born of mind-contact. This is the aggregate of mental formations as a manifold class.
As another manifold class: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may be joined with pleasant feeling, joined with painful feeling, or joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of formations may be joined with pleasant feeling… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; and there is intention born of eye-contact, intention born of ear-contact, intention born of nose-contact, intention born of tongue-contact, intention born of body-contact, and intention born of mind-contact. This is the aggregate of mental formations as a manifold class.
This is called the aggregate of mental formations.

There is consciousness that is a result… there is consciousness with an internal object, consciousness with an external object, and consciousness with an object both internal and external… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.
The set rooted in the pairs.

content: As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness that the hindrances can obstruct, and consciousness they cannot. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is consciousness with an internal object, consciousness with an external object, and consciousness with an object both internal and external… Thus the aggregate of consciousness is classified up to ten ways.
The set expanding from both sides.

As a sevenfold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: there is wholesome consciousness, unwholesome consciousness, neutral consciousness, consciousness belonging to the sense sphere, consciousness belonging to the fine-material sphere, consciousness belonging to the immaterial sphere, and consciousness not included in any sphere. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a sevenfold class.

As another sevenfold class: there is consciousness joined with pleasant feeling, consciousness joined with painful feeling, consciousness joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant, consciousness belonging to the sense sphere, consciousness belonging to the fine-material sphere, consciousness belonging to the immaterial sphere, and consciousness not included in any sphere… there is consciousness with an internal object, consciousness with an external object, consciousness with an object both internal and external, consciousness belonging to the sense sphere, consciousness belonging to the fine-material sphere, consciousness belonging to the immaterial sphere, and consciousness not included in any sphere. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a sevenfold class.

As a twenty-fourfold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a twenty-fourfold class.

As another twenty-fourfold class: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be joined with pleasant feeling, joined with painful feeling, or joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external; and there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness and mind-consciousness; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a twenty-fourfold class.

As a thirtyfold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a thirtyfold class.

As a manifold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere – eye-consciousness… mind-consciousness; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere – eye-consciousness… mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a manifold class.

As another manifold class: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be joined with pleasant feeling… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be joined with pleasant feeling… may have an internal object, an external object, or an object both internal and external, may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a manifold class.
This is called the aggregate of consciousness.
The Classification According to the Abhidhamma is finished.

content: Four aggregates are not root causes. The aggregate of mental formations may be a root cause or not. The aggregate of material form is without root causes. The other four aggregates may have root causes or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from root causes. The other four aggregates may be joined with root causes or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a root cause with root causes" or as "having root causes without being a root cause". Three aggregates cannot be described as "root causes with root causes"; they may have root causes without being root causes, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a root cause with root causes, may have root causes without being a root cause, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a root cause joined with root causes" or as "joined with root causes without being a root cause". Three aggregates cannot be described as "root causes joined with root causes"; they may be joined with root causes without being root causes, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a root cause joined with root causes, may be joined with root causes without being a root cause, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is not a root cause and is without root causes. Three aggregates may be not root causes with root causes, or not root causes without root causes. The aggregate of mental formations may be not a root cause with root causes, not a root cause without root causes, or not describable as either.
All five have conditions and are compounded.

Four aggregates are invisible. The aggregate of material form may be visible or invisible. Four aggregates offer no resistance. The aggregate of material form may offer resistance or not. The aggregate of material form is material. The other four aggregates are immaterial. The aggregate of material form is worldly. The other four aggregates may be worldly or beyond the world; all are knowable by some kinds of consciousness and not knowable by others.

Four aggregates are not mental taints. The aggregate of mental formations may be a taint or not. The aggregate of material form is subject to the taints. The other four aggregates may be subject to the taints or free of them. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the taints. The other four aggregates may be joined with the taints or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a taint subject to the taints"; it is subject to the taints without being a taint. Three aggregates cannot be described as "taints subject to the taints"; they may be subject to the taints without being taints, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a taint subject to the taints, may be subject to the taints without being a taint, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a taint joined with the taints" or as "joined with the taints without being a taint". Three aggregates cannot be described as "taints joined with the taints"; they may be joined with the taints without being taints, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a taint joined with the taints, may be joined with the taints without being a taint, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the taints yet subject to them. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the taints yet subject to them, dissociated from them and free of them, or not describable as either.

Four aggregates are not fetters. The aggregate of mental formations may be a fetter or not. The aggregate of material form can be bound by the fetters. The other four aggregates may be able to be bound or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the fetters. The other four aggregates may be joined with the fetters or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a fetter that can be bound"; it can be bound without being a fetter. Three aggregates cannot be described as "fetters that can be bound"; they may be able to be bound without being fetters, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a fetter that can be bound, may be able to be bound without being a fetter, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a fetter joined with the fetters" or as "joined with the fetters without being a fetter". Three aggregates cannot be described as "fetters joined with the fetters"; they may be joined with the fetters without being fetters, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a fetter joined with the fetters, may be joined with the fetters without being a fetter, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the fetters yet able to be bound. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the fetters yet able to be bound, dissociated from them and unable to be bound, or not describable as either.

Four aggregates are not ties. The aggregate of mental formations may be a tie or not. The aggregate of material form can be tied. The other four aggregates may be able to be tied or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the ties. The other four aggregates may be joined with the ties or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a tie that can be tied"; it can be tied without being a tie. Three aggregates cannot be described as "ties that can be tied"; they may be able to be tied without being ties, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a tie that can be tied, may be able to be tied without being a tie, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of mental formations may be a tie joined with the ties, may be joined with the ties without being a tie, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the ties yet able to be tied. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the ties yet able to be tied, dissociated from them and unable to be tied, or not describable as either.

Four aggregates are not floods… not yokes… not hindrances. The aggregate of mental formations may be a hindrance or not. The aggregate of material form can be obstructed by the hindrances. The other four aggregates may be able to be obstructed or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the hindrances. The other four aggregates may be joined with the hindrances or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a hindrance that can be obstructed"; it can be obstructed without being a hindrance. Three aggregates cannot be described as "hindrances that can be obstructed"; they may be able to be obstructed without being hindrances, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a hindrance that can be obstructed, may be able to be obstructed without being a hindrance, or may not be describable as either. Three aggregates cannot be described as "hindrances joined with the hindrances"; they may be joined with the hindrances without being hindrances, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a hindrance joined with the hindrances, may be joined with the hindrances without being a hindrance, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the hindrances yet able to be obstructed. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the hindrances yet able to be obstructed, dissociated from them and unable to be obstructed, or not describable as either.

Four aggregates are not wrong grasping. The aggregate of mental formations may be wrong grasping or not. The aggregate of material form can be wrongly grasped. The other four aggregates may be able to be wrongly grasped or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from wrong grasping. Three aggregates may be joined with wrong grasping or dissociated from it. The aggregate of mental formations may be joined with wrong grasping, dissociated from it, or not describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "wrong grasping that can be wrongly grasped"; it can be wrongly grasped without being wrong grasping. Three aggregates cannot be described as "wrong grasping that can be wrongly grasped"; they may be able to be wrongly grasped without being wrong grasping, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be wrong grasping that can be wrongly grasped, may be able to be wrongly grasped without being wrong grasping, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from wrong grasping yet able to be wrongly grasped. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from wrong grasping yet able to be wrongly grasped, dissociated from it and unable to be wrongly grasped, or not describable as either.

The aggregate of material form has no object. The other four aggregates have objects. The aggregate of consciousness is mind. The other four aggregates are not mind. Three aggregates are mental factors. Two aggregates are not mental factors. Three aggregates are joined with mind. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from mind. The aggregate of consciousness cannot be described as "joined with mind" or as "dissociated from mind". Three aggregates are mingled with mind. The aggregate of material form is not mingled with mind. The aggregate of consciousness cannot be described as "mingled with mind" or as "not mingled with mind". Three aggregates are produced by mind. The aggregate of consciousness is not produced by mind. The aggregate of material form may be produced by mind or not. Three aggregates arise together with mind. The aggregate of consciousness does not arise together with mind. The aggregate of material form may arise together with mind or not. Three aggregates follow along with mind. The aggregate of consciousness does not follow along with mind. The aggregate of material form may follow along with mind or not. Three aggregates are mingled with mind and produced by it. Two aggregates are not mingled with mind and produced by it. Three aggregates are mingled with mind, produced by it, and arise together with it. Two aggregates are not. Three aggregates are mingled with mind, produced by it, and follow along with it. Two aggregates are not.

The aggregate of consciousness is internal. Three aggregates are external. The aggregate of material form may be internal or external. Four aggregates are not derived. The aggregate of material form may be derived or not derived, may be taken up at birth or not taken up. Four aggregates are not clinging. The aggregate of mental formations may be clinging or not. The aggregate of material form can be clung to. The other four aggregates may be able to be clung to or not. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from clinging. The other four aggregates may be joined with clinging or dissociated from it. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "clinging that can be clung to"; it can be clung to without being clinging. Three aggregates cannot be described as "clinging that can be clung to"; they may be able to be clung to without being clinging, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be clinging that can be clung to, may be able to be clung to without being clinging, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "clinging joined with clinging" or as "joined with clinging without being clinging". Three aggregates cannot be described as "clinging joined with clinging"; they may be joined with clinging without being clinging, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be clinging joined with clinging, may be joined with clinging without being clinging, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from clinging yet able to be clung to. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from clinging yet able to be clung to, dissociated from it and unable to be clung to, or not describable as either.

Four aggregates are not defilements. The aggregate of mental formations may be a defilement or not. The aggregate of material form is open to defilement. The other four aggregates may be open to defilement or not. The aggregate of material form is undefiled. The other four aggregates may be defiled or undefiled. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the defilements. The other four aggregates may be joined with the defilements or dissociated from them. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a defilement open to defilement"; it is open to defilement without being a defilement. Three aggregates cannot be described as "defilements open to defilement"; they may be open to defilement without being defilements, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a defilement open to defilement, may be open to defilement without being a defilement, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a defilement that is defiled" or as "defiled without being a defilement". Three aggregates cannot be described as "defilements that are defiled"; they may be defiled without being defilements, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a defilement that is defiled, may be defiled without being a defilement, or may not be describable as either.

The aggregate of material form cannot be described as "a defilement joined with the defilements" or as "joined with the defilements without being a defilement". Three aggregates cannot be described as "defilements joined with the defilements"; they may be joined with the defilements without being defilements, or may not be describable as such. The aggregate of mental formations may be a defilement joined with the defilements, may be joined with the defilements without being a defilement, or may not be describable as either. The aggregate of material form is dissociated from the defilements yet open to defilement. The other four aggregates may be dissociated from the defilements yet open to defilement, dissociated from them and not open to defilement, or not describable as either.

The aggregate of material form is not to be abandoned by seeing. The other four aggregates may be abandoned by seeing or not. The aggregate of material form is not to be abandoned by meditative development. The other four aggregates may be abandoned by development or not. The aggregate of material form does not have root causes to be abandoned by seeing. The other four aggregates may have root causes to be abandoned by seeing or not. The aggregate of material form does not have root causes to be abandoned by development. The other four aggregates may have root causes to be abandoned by development or not. The aggregate of material form is without thought. The other four aggregates may have thought or not. The aggregate of material form is without examination. The other four aggregates may have examination or not. The aggregate of material form is without joy. The other four aggregates may have joy or not. The aggregate of material form is not accompanied by joy. The other four aggregates may be accompanied by joy or not. Two aggregates are not accompanied by happiness. Three aggregates may be accompanied by happiness or not. Two aggregates are not accompanied by equanimity. Three aggregates may be accompanied by equanimity or not.

The aggregate of material form belongs to the sense sphere. The other four aggregates may belong to the sense sphere or not. The aggregate of material form does not belong to the fine-material sphere. The other four aggregates may belong to the fine-material sphere or not. The aggregate of material form does not belong to the immaterial sphere. The other four aggregates may belong to the immaterial sphere or not. The aggregate of material form is included in the round of existence. The other four aggregates may be included in the round of existence or outside it. The aggregate of material form does not lead out of the round. The other four aggregates may lead out of the round or not. The aggregate of material form is not fixed in its outcome. The other four aggregates may be fixed or not fixed. The aggregate of material form can be surpassed. The other four aggregates may be surpassable or unsurpassable. content: Therein, what is the sense-field of mental objects? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the material form that is invisible and offers no resistance and is included in the sense-field of mental objects, and the unconditioned element. ⤵ Therein, what is the aggregate of feeling? As a single class, the aggregate of feeling is joined with contact. As a twofold class: there is feeling with a root cause, and feeling without one. As a threefold class: there is wholesome feeling, unwholesome feeling, and neutral feeling… thus the aggregate of feeling is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of feeling is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of feeling". ⤵ Therein, what is the aggregate of perception? As a single class, the aggregate of perception is joined with contact. As a twofold class: there is perception with a root cause, and perception without one. As a threefold class: there is wholesome perception, unwholesome perception, and neutral perception… thus the aggregate of perception is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of perception is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of perception". ⤵ Therein, what is the aggregate of mental formations? As a single class, the aggregate of mental formations is joined with mind. As a twofold class: there are formations that are root causes, and formations that are not. As a threefold class: there are wholesome formations, unwholesome formations, and neutral formations… thus the aggregate of mental formations is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of mental formations is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of mental formations". ⤵ Therein, what is the material form that is invisible, offers no resistance, and is included in the sense-field of mental objects? The faculty of femininity, the faculty of masculinity… physical food. This is called the material form that is "invisible, offers no resistance, and is included in the sense-field of mental objects". ⤵ Therein, what is the unconditioned element? The ending of desire, the ending of hatred, and the ending of delusion – this is called "the unconditioned element".
This is called the sense-field of mental objects.
The Classification According to the Abhidhamma is finished.

content: Therein, what is the pleasure element? Bodily comfort, bodily pleasure; the comfortable, pleasant experience born of body-contact; the comfortable, pleasant feeling born of body-contact – this is called "the pleasure element". ⤵ Therein, what is the pain element? Bodily discomfort, bodily pain; the uncomfortable, painful experience born of body-contact; the uncomfortable, painful feeling born of body-contact – this is called "the pain element". ⤵ Therein, what is the gladness element? Mental comfort, mental pleasure; the comfortable, pleasant experience born of mind-contact; the comfortable, pleasant feeling born of mind-contact – this is called "the gladness element". ⤵ Therein, what is the sadness element? Mental discomfort, mental pain; the uncomfortable, painful experience born of mind-contact; the uncomfortable, painful feeling born of mind-contact – this is called "the sadness element". ⤵ Therein, what is the equanimity element? What is mentally neither comfortable nor uncomfortable; the experience born of mind-contact that is neither painful nor pleasant; the feeling born of mind-contact that is neither painful nor pleasant – this is called "the equanimity element". ⤵ Therein, what is the ignorance element? Not knowing, not seeing, not comprehending, not awakening, not fully awakening, not penetrating, not grasping, not fathoming, not weighing evenly, not reflecting, not seeing directly; poor discernment, foolishness, lack of clear understanding; delusion, bewilderment, complete confusion; ignorance, the flood of ignorance, the yoke of ignorance, the underlying tendency to ignorance, the obsession of ignorance, the barrier of ignorance; delusion, the root of the unwholesome – this is called "the ignorance element".
These are the six elements.

content: Therein, what is the element of sense desire? Thinking connected with sense desire – thought, intention, fixing, focusing, directing the mind, wrong intention – this is called the element of sense desire. Taking the Avīci hell as the lower limit and the gods who wield power over others' creations as the upper limit, whatever within this range moves here and is included here – the aggregates, elements, and sense-fields, material form, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness – this is called "the element of sense desire". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of ill will? Thinking connected with ill will – thought… wrong intention – this is called "the element of ill will". Or the mind's irritation over the ten grounds for resentment: hostility, resistance, opposition; anger, rage, fury; hatred, ill feeling, malice; the mind's vexation, mental resentment; anger, being angry, the state of being angry; hatred, hating, the state of hating; vexation, being vexed; opposition, hostility; ferocity, harshness, and the mind's displeasure – this is called "the element of ill will". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of cruelty? Thinking connected with cruelty – thought… wrong intention – this is called "the element of cruelty". Here someone harms living beings with a hand, a clod, a stick, a knife, a rope, or with one thing or another; such tormenting, harassing, hurting, injuring, provoking, and attacking of others – this is called "the element of cruelty". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of renunciation? Thinking connected with renunciation – thought… right intention – this is called "the element of renunciation". Indeed, all wholesome states are "the element of renunciation". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of goodwill? Thinking connected with goodwill – thought… right intention – this is called "the element of goodwill". Loving-kindness towards living beings, the act of loving, the state of loving, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness – this is called "the element of goodwill". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of harmlessness? Thinking connected with harmlessness – thought, intention, fixing, focusing, directing the mind, right intention – this is called "the element of harmlessness". Compassion towards living beings, the act of compassion, the state of compassion, the liberation of mind through compassion – this is called "the element of harmlessness".
These are the six elements.
Thus these three sets of six, gathered and grouped together, make eighteen elements.
The Classification According to the Discourses is finished.

As a threefold class: there is wholesome feeling, unwholesome feeling, and neutral feeling… thus the aggregate of feeling is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of feeling is classified in many ways. As a threefold class: there are wholesome formations, unwholesome formations, and neutral formations… thus the aggregate of mental formations is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of mental formations is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of mental formations". ⤵ Therein, what is the material form that is invisible, offers no resistance, and is included in the sense-field of mental objects? content: There are eighteen elements – the eye element, the element of sights, the eye-consciousness element; the ear element, the element of sounds, the ear-consciousness element; the nose element, the element of smells, the nose-consciousness element; the tongue element, the element of tastes, the tongue-consciousness element; the body element, the element of things touched, the body-consciousness element; the mind element, the element of mental objects, and the mind-consciousness element.
Of the eighteen elements, how many are wholesome, how many unwholesome, how many neutral… how many involve conflict, how many are free from conflict?

content: Therein, what is the noble truth of the way leading to the ending of suffering? It is just this noble eightfold path, namely: right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration. ⤵ Therein, what is right view? Knowledge of suffering, knowledge of the origin of suffering, knowledge of the ending of suffering, knowledge of the way leading to the ending of suffering – this is called "right view". ⤵ Therein, what is right intention? The intention of renunciation, the intention of goodwill, the intention of harmlessness – this is called "right intention". ⤵ Therein, what is right speech? Refraining from false speech, refraining from divisive speech, refraining from harsh speech, refraining from idle chatter – this is called "right speech". ⤵ Therein, what is right action? Refraining from killing living beings, refraining from taking what is not given, refraining from sexual misconduct – this is called "right action". ⤵ Therein, what is right livelihood? Here a noble disciple, having abandoned wrong livelihood, makes a living by right livelihood – this is called "right livelihood". ⤵ Therein, what is right effort? Here a monk generates desire, strives, arouses energy, applies the mind, and endeavours for the non-arising of bad, unwholesome states that have not yet arisen. He generates desire, strives, arouses energy, applies the mind, and endeavours for the abandoning of bad, unwholesome states that have arisen. He generates desire, strives, arouses energy, applies the mind, and endeavours for the arising of wholesome states that have not yet arisen. He generates desire, strives, arouses energy, applies the mind, and endeavours for the maintaining, non-confusion, increase, expansion, development, and fulfilment of wholesome states that have arisen. This is called "right effort". ⤵ Therein, what is right mindfulness? Here a monk dwells contemplating the body in the body – ardent, clearly understanding, and mindful, having put away covetousness and sadness towards the world. He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings… the mind in the mind… mental objects in mental objects – ardent, clearly understanding, and mindful, having put away covetousness and sadness towards the world. This is called "right mindfulness". ⤵ Therein, what is right concentration? Here a monk, secluded from sense pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption, which has thought and examination and the joy and happiness born of seclusion. With the stilling of thought and examination, he enters and dwells in the second meditative absorption, which has inner confidence and unification of mind, is without thought and examination, and has the joy and happiness born of concentration. With the fading away of joy, he dwells with equanimity, mindful and clearly understanding, and experiences happiness with the body; he enters and dwells in the third meditative absorption, of which the noble ones declare: "Equanimous and mindful, one dwells happily." With the abandoning of pleasure and the abandoning of pain, and with the earlier disappearance of gladness and sadness, he enters and dwells in the fourth meditative absorption, which is neither painful nor pleasant and has purity of mindfulness through equanimity. This is called "right concentration". ⤵ This is called "the noble truth of the way leading to the ending of suffering".
The Classification According to the Discourses is finished.

content: Therein, what is the origin of suffering? Craving, the remaining defilements, the remaining unwholesome states, the three wholesome roots that are subject to the mental taints, and the remaining wholesome states subject to the taints – this is called "the origin of suffering". ⤵ Therein, what is suffering? The results of wholesome and unwholesome states subject to the taints, the states that are mere functioning – neither wholesome nor unwholesome nor the results of action – and all material form – this is called "suffering". ⤵ Therein, what is the ending of suffering? The abandoning of craving, of the remaining defilements, of the remaining unwholesome states, of the three wholesome roots subject to the taints, and of the remaining wholesome states subject to the taints – this is called "the ending of suffering". ⤵ Therein, what is the way leading to the ending of suffering? Here, on an occasion when a monk develops the meditative absorption that is beyond the world, leading out of the round, leading to dismantling, for the abandoning of wrong views and for reaching the first stage – secluded from sense pleasures… he enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption, the way being difficult and direct knowledge slow – on that occasion there is contact… there is non-distraction. This is called "the way leading to the ending of suffering".
The Classification According to the Abhidhamma is finished.
